fullDescription:
Classic size Happy Planner Canva template ready to edit! Print as is or use a free Canva account to change the colors, fonts, page arrangement. Create a fully themed retro inspired month in you planner. Print the currently page, divider, monthly view and weekly view to create complete themed month. Use the daily inserts individually to plan busy days. Notes pages are included to complete the theme.

Pages are 7 x 9.25 inches and fit a classic size planner – commonly the Classic Size Happy Planner. All elements are fully editable – change the colors, layout, font, etc.

Pages include:
– left and right punch dashboard/currently page
– divider page
– 2 monthly views
– classic vertical weekly view
– 2 color block weekly views
– lined vertical weekly view
– hourly weekly view
– left and right punched daily pages
-left and right punched notes pages

** This is a digital item, no physical item will be shipped to you **

You will only receive a PDF with a link to the Canva template. Use this link to access the template with your Free Canva Account.

If you are ready to print immediately without any edits simply choose the ‘share’ option in the upper right and download as a PDF with bleed. If you’d like to edit colors, fonts, etc, complete those edits and follow the same instructions – select the ‘share’ option in the upper right and download as PDF with bleed. It would be beneficial to make a test print to make sure your printer isn’t scaling the images – often you should choose actual size when printing. It would also be helpful to make a plan of which pages you’ll be printing back to front as this template is not optimized for immediate printing.
